jobs.description:
Materials Science Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Core Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, .NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework.

  • Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations.

  • Delivery & Test Engineering: Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing.

  • AI Adoption & Technical Leadership: Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.

  • Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development: Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows.

  • Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance.

  • Technical Debt & Governance: Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints.

  • Problem solving & Troubleshooting: Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment.

  • Backend Stack: Deep expertise in C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs.

  • Databases: Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures.

  • Cloud & DevOps: Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines.

  • Testing: Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools.

  • Artificial Intelligence: Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Remote (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Marketing | Reports to: Director, Revenue Marketing

Time Doctor is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the marketing-led customer journey from the moment an account starts paying. You will decide who hears what, when, based on which behaviour, and toward which commercial outcome. Your job is to turn customer behaviour and usage signals into adoption, retention, expansion and reactivation revenue, and to run that engine AI-first, building agents and agentic workflows that do real work.

Who we are

Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role

You will own the lifecycle marketing program for our paying customers: the 30/60/90 onboarding plays, ongoing customer communications, customer segmentation, and the expansion and retention plays that grow and keep the base. You design the journeys, brief the work, QA it and measure it, and you own the revenue outcome.

Three things define this seat.

  • The number. Your primary measure is the qualified expansion and cross-sell opportunities Lifecycle generates and surfaces. Expansion revenue, net revenue retention and at-risk recovery sit right behind it, shared with CS, Sales and Product.

  • The lane. You own orchestration and outcomes across the customer base, not every surface you touch. PMM owns the message, GTM Ops builds the scoring and routing, and Growth and CS co-define the signals with you. You make it all work together.

  • The operating model. This is an AI-first role, and AI fluency is the job. The bar is that you can stand up an agent that does real work, not describe one. Accelerating Time Doctor's AI-first operating model is an explicit expectation of the seat.

This is a systems role. You build repeatable, automated journeys rather than one-off campaigns, and you keep human ownership of segmentation logic, offer design, guardrails, final QA and the commercial call.

Who you are

  • You treat a revenue number as yours, and you design every journey toward adoption, retention or expansion.

  • You have high agency. When a journey underperforms, you find out why and fix it.

  • You are commercially minded. You turn customer signals into revenue.

  • You are analytical and cohort-fluent. You read behaviour and act on where customers stall or grow.

  • You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable, automated flow than run another one-off campaign.

  • You work cleanly across Growth, CS, PMM and GTM Ops without needing to own their surfaces, and you turn ambiguous boundaries into working agreements.

  • You build with AI. Agents and agentic workflows are how you get work done.

What you will own

  • Onboarding and adoption. The marketing-led 30/60/90 program that gets new paying customers to first value, plus ongoing adoption of key capabilities and education, including driving traffic to TD Academy and running education webinars end to end. You own the day-0 handoff: the trigger and the data that enrol a new customer in the right journey.

  • Segmentation and journey orchestration. Segmenting paying customers on profile, product usage, engagement, lifecycle stage, adoption state, expansion propensity and churn risk, then designing, building and QA-ing the journeys and triggers on top, so the right cohort gets the right play at the right moment.

  • Expansion and cross-sell. Plays that grow existing accounts through seats, add-ons and cross-sell. You co-define expansion signals with Growth and CS, turn them into segments and plays, and route qualified opportunities to Sales and CS, with GTM Ops implementing detection and actions.

  • Retention and win-back. Proactive plays against at-risk cohorts, air cover for CS retention efforts, re-engagement of dormant accounts, and win-back of churned accounts where it is commercially worthwhile.

  • Renewal-moment marketing. Value-recap and air-cover campaigns timed to the renewal window, reinforcing realised value ahead of the CS conversation.

  • Customer communications. Audience, segmentation, timing and orchestration for the customer newsletter, customer webinars, feature and release comms, and lifecycle-triggered in-app announcements. PMM owns the message. You own distribution.

  • Advocacy and review sites. Identifying advocates and triggering review, referral, testimonial and reference asks at the right lifecycle moment, including activating the promoters CS surfaces through NPS. You fully own review-site management and take the case studies Content and PMM produce to market.

  • Lifecycle analytics and experimentation. Performance across every journey, from onboarding completion and time-to-value through to expansion, retention, renewal support and win-back. You find where customers stall, drop off, expand or disengage, and you keep improving the programs.

  • AI in the workflow. Agentic workflows for segmentation, usage and account signal interpretation, journey and trigger build and testing, customer comms drafting and variants, propensity and churn scoring drafts, cohort analysis and drop-off detection. You decide what runs autonomously, what needs human judgement, and how each workflow gets operationalised with GTM Ops.

This role may not suit you if

  • You measure yourself on sends, opens and campaign volume rather than on revenue adopted, kept and grown.

  • You prefer launching one-off campaigns to building journeys that run on their own.

  • AI for you means prompt libraries and screenshots. We need someone who has built agents that do real work.

  • Your experience is mostly top-of-funnel. This role starts the moment an account becomes a paying customer.

  • You need to own every surface you touch. PMM owns the message and GTM Ops builds the scoring and routing, and this seat depends on working well with both.

  • You cannot commit to at least four hours a day of overlap with US Eastern business hours.

What a realistic week looks like

A cohort review showing where last month's new customers stalled before day 30, and a fix to the onboarding journey that ships the same week. A working session with CS on an at-risk cohort and the play you will run against it. Two expansion opportunities your signals surfaced, qualified and routed to Sales. An agent you built to draft and QA journey variants, tightened after its first run. A value-recap campaign going out to accounts entering their renewal window. Live collaboration during US Eastern hours, async for the rest of the day.

Requirements

Your experience

  • 5 to 7 years in lifecycle, CRM, customer or retention marketing at a B2B SaaS company.

  • A track record of designing and running behaviour-triggered customer journeys, with adoption, retention or expansion outcomes you owned. You know your numbers and can walk us through them.

  • Comfortable working from product-usage and account data to define segments, propensity and churn logic. You can specify the scoring and routing, even though GTM Ops builds it.

  • Fluent in a marketing automation or lifecycle stack such as HubSpot, and in cohort analysis.

  • Experience running expansion, cross-sell or renewal-support programs, and coordinating opportunity handoff with CS and Sales.

  • A clear understanding of where lifecycle ends and Growth and CS begin, and the ability to work cleanly across those lines.

  • Hands-on experience building agents or agentic workflows that do real work. You can show us what you built and what it does.

  • Remote, with a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern (ET) business hours.

Nice to have

  • Product-led SaaS experience.

  • More than four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

  • Background in workforce analytics, time tracking, HR tech or productivity software.

  • Experience marketing to BPO, outsourcing, healthcare or tech services customers.

The team you are joining

You will report to our Director, Revenue Marketing. You will work closely with Growth and CS on expansion and churn signals, with PMM and Content on messaging and proof assets, with GTM Ops on scoring, routing and journey implementation, and with Sales and CS on the opportunities you hand forward.

How we will measure success

  • Qualified expansion and cross-sell opportunities you generate and surface. This is the headline measure and the one you control most directly.

  • Expansion revenue, net revenue retention contribution and at-risk recovery, which CS, Sales and Product also influence.

  • Onboarding completion, time-to-value and product adoption depth among paying customers, as the leading indicators.

  • Advocacy volume across reviews, referrals and references, renewal-support coverage, and revenue recovered through win-back.

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30. Map the post-conversion journey and where customers stall. Audit the current 30/60/90 onboarding and customer comms. Document the conversion handoff: the trigger and the data that must travel with a new customer. Agree the first expansion and churn signals with Growth and CS, and baseline adoption, retention and expansion.

  • Days 31 to 60. Launch or repair the 30/60/90 onboarding. Stand up the first expansion play and one renewal-moment campaign. Set up cohort reporting, introduce AI-assisted segmentation and comms, and get review-site management and one advocacy trigger (NPS promoters from CS) live.

  • Days 61 to 90. Scale the expansion and retention plays that are working. Run a win-back pilot. Establish expansion-opportunity routing to Sales and CS with GTM Ops, then present the adoption, retention and expansion baseline alongside a lifecycle roadmap.

Why this role

  • You own a real revenue number, from the moment a customer converts.

  • You get a clear lane. Growth, CS, PMM and GTM Ops are your partners, and your focus is orchestration and outcomes.

  • You work AI-first from day one, at a company where accelerating an AI-first operating model is an explicit expectation.

  • We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

  • Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.

Our hiring approach

Because this is an AI-first role, our process asks you to prove it. Expect a working session where you show agents or agentic workflows you have built, then stand up or walk through one live, applied to a real customer-lifecycle problem. Prompt libraries and screenshots are not enough. We want to see how you architect, orchestrate and operationalise the work.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

We hire globally, and this particular role requires a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

You'll work closely with Finance, Legal, Operations, and Support to understand real problems and ship practical automation that people actually use. jobs.description:
Community Manager – Algo Business

Delta Exchange India

Team: Product

Location: Remote (India)

Type: Full-time

About Delta Exchange India

Delta Exchange India is one of India's leading crypto derivatives platforms, offering INR-settled futures and options on Bitcoin, Ethereum and other major cryptocurrencies on an FIU-registered platform. Automation is core to our product — through REST/WebSocket APIs, Webhooks, Algo Marketplace and our AI-powered API Copilot, we're making algorithmic trading accessible to everyone from quants and developers to first-time automated traders.

About the Role

We're looking for a Community Manager – Algo Business to build one of the most trusted crypto algo trading communities.

India's algo traders are scattered across Telegram groups, Discord servers and Twitter threads. We want Delta to be where that community actually lives — where a beginner deploys their first bot and an experienced quant compares notes on execution.

This role is for someone who genuinely loves talking to algo traders. You'll spend your days in conversation with users — in Online forums, on calls, at meetups — and turn what you learn into content, events and product feedback. Success isn't measured in follower counts, but in how many traders are actively building and deploying on Delta.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own our community across Online Community forums — structure, rituals, moderation, day-to-day engagement.
  • Be the first responder: answer questions, unblock traders, escalate bugs, make sure no API question goes unanswered.
  • Identify and nurture power users and strategy builders; run ambassador and early-access programmes.
  • Plan and execute offline meetups, hackathons and strategy competitions across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and other hubs — plus online AMAs, workshops and guest sessions.
  • Create content that lowers the barrier to algo trading: getting-started guides, API tutorials, strategy walkthroughs, backtesting explainers.
  • Keep documentation, sample code and cookbooks genuinely useful — you should be able to write and test a basic strategy yourself.
  • Capture community pain points and translate them into structured, prioritised product feedback.
  • Track what's brewing globally — agentic tooling, AI copilots, no-code automation — and bring it back to our users and our roadmap.
  • Define and track community metrics: active builders, deployed strategies, resolution time, new-trader retention.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years in community management, developer relations, growth, content or a trader-facing role. Exceptional candidates with less formal experience but deep algo credibility will be considered.
  • A real understanding of algo trading — you know what a backtest is, why slippage matters, what a webhook does. You don't need to be a quant, but you can't be faking it in front of one.
  • You genuinely enjoy talking to traders. This role involves hundreds of conversations a month.
  • Awareness of the algo landscape in India and globally — the tools, the communities, the interesting builders, where it's heading.
  • Strong written communication: a clear tutorial, a crisp announcement, well-structured product feedback.
  • Comfort with technical material — API docs, sample code, explaining a strategy to a beginner.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to travel for events.

Good to Have

  • Hands-on experience building, backtesting or running your own strategies or bots.
  • Existing network in Indian trading, quant or developer communities.
  • Experience running Discord/Telegram communities at scale, or organising meetups and hackathons.
  • Ability to write Python well enough to build demos and debug user issues.
  • Personal trading experience in crypto or Indian markets.

Delta Exchange India is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
